name: XChange - Where Market Chatter Becomes Market Insight
tagline: Turns market chatter on X into ranked trading signals with paper trading.

awards: Most Impactful Use of the X API by X

problem: Social hype moves stocks but the volume of chatter hides the signal.
solution: AI sentiment and trend analysis of posts feeds a dashboard with watchlists, unusual-flow alerts, chat and paper trading.
demo_moment: Team-described: see a stock trending and why, then paper-trade it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Most Impactful Use of the X API by X” among 195 submissions.
Uses the sponsor's own data as the product.

lessons: Platform-data prizes reward signal over noise.
